stations.title: Your functions
tasks: A kind not on the list

captions: At the store, Dougie asks how many splints are left after Saturday's orders.
Today an order for more than the shelf holds goes through, and the count goes below zero.
You refuse a bad order before anything changes, with a message that says what is wrong.
Now the order that was too big is refused, and the splint count stays true.
The store's counts can be trusted, and every refusal says what to put right.
